visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of grey textured curtains being drawn, then pulled back to reveal a bright, modern room. A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing white silk-like pajamas with a subtle bow pattern, stretches her arms while sitting on a large white-sheeted bed. The lighting is soft and natural from the large windows. (2) The scene shifts to the woman sitting on a wide window sill, looking out at a sprawling cityscape under a clear blue sky. She then appears in a spacious, marble-tiled bathroom. She stands near a large, freestanding white oval bathtub. The room features white horizontal blinds, dual rectangular sinks, and a large mirror reflecting her presence. (3) Quick cuts show various room details: a flat-screen TV mounted on a wooden rotating stand, a light-colored wooden cabinet, and a living area with a long light-grey sofa and a round wooden coffee table. The camera captures her hand opening a mini-fridge containing various bottled beverages and a Nespresso coffee machine with colorful pods. (4) Detailed shots show the woman interacting with amenities. Her hands fill a transparent water tank at a modern tap, insert it into the Nespresso machine, and place a pod. She then holds a glass of freshly brewed coffee. She shows two black packets of steam eye masks and a small blue sachet of bath salts. (5) In the final sequence, the woman is seen in the bathroom again, now applying makeup and brushing her hair. She changes into a grey sleeveless sweater and a leopard-print midi skirt. She poses in front of the mirror, finalizing her look before the video ends with a view of her smiling.
